plan: I will use the Nash equilibrium bidding strategy for this game. With 3 bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid two-thirds of your value. My value is $22, so I will bid 2/3 * 22 = 14.666... Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I will bid $14.7.

This is a single-round auction, so long-term learning isn't applicable. My value is $15. I need to bid strategically to maximize my profit if I win. A rational bidding strategy involves bidding below my true value. Let's bid slightly below half my value to try and secure a win with a decent profit margin. I will bid $7.4.

This is a single-round auction. My value is $10. Since all bidders are rational, I should bid slightly below my value. A common strategy in these scenarios is to bid a bit lower than your actual value to ensure a profit margin if you win. I'll bid $9.9.
